about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm a Software Development Analyst and Full Stack Developer at Invent Software, a company specialising in add-ons for the SAP ecosystem focused on fiscal and financial management. Since November 2021, I've worked from requirements gathering to delivery, integrating desktop systems, cloud applications and external APIs.
about.p2: I hold a degree in Systems Analysis and Development from Universidade Estácio de Sá, with additional online coursework. I work with C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL and SAPUI5, always aiming for testable code (TDD) and sustainable solutions within squads with collaboratively defined scopes.
